rows.commentary: 0.1: Jayden Seales begins with a probing length in the channel that nips back sharply to rap Shadman Islam high on the thigh pad.
0.2: Jayden Seales attacks the stumps from a back of a length, eliciting a solid defensive block from a watchful Shadman Islam.
0.3: Seales probes that probing channel on a nagging length, extracting sharp away-movement as Shadman wisely withdraws his bat.
0.4: Jayden Seales hurries the batter with a hard length outside off that seams away past Shadman Islam's ambitious square cut.
0.5: Jayden Seales extracts sharp bounce and inward movement from a short of length, prompting another clean leave from Shadman Islam.
0.6: Jayden Seales seals a probing maiden over as a 134-click delivery leaves the corridor, safely ignored by Shadman Islam.
1.1: Joseph charges in to hurl a fullish delivery angling away outside off, leaving Tanzid to shoulder arms with absolute precision.
1.2: Shamar Joseph clocks 136.8 kph with a full offering outside off, stabbed out toward short cover by the toe-end of Tanzid Hasan Tamim's bat.
1.3: Shamar Joseph rattles the pitch at 143.7 kph to find straight movement past Tanzid Hasan Tamim, who watches it pass.
1.4: Shamar Joseph unleashes a 145.6 kph thunderbolt that skids alarmingly low, forcing Amir Jangoo to throw his body behind the line.
1.5: Shamar Joseph offers width at 145.8 kph, allowing Tanzid Hasan Tamim to open the face and steer a crisp drive through the covers for three runs.
1.6: Shamar Joseph fires in a 145-click delivery on the fourth stump, met by a resolute front-foot defense from Shadman Islam.
2.1: Seales steams in from round the wicket at one-thirty-seven kph, angling full into off stump as Tanzid tentatively jabs it off the inner half toward square leg.
2.2: Seales targets that wide sixth stump channel with a sharp delivery, and Tanzid wisely watches it sail past his waist.
2.3: Seales hits a back of a length outside off, jagging it back in sharply as Tanzid raises his blade skyward to let it go.
12.1: Roston Chase floats a full delivery down the leg-side, and Mominul sweeps it firmly to the left of deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
12.2: Roston Chase extracts sharp turn and extra bounce from a length on off, beating Mominul completely on the outside edge as he leans forward to block.
12.3: Roston Chase tosses up a flighted delivery on off, and Mominul lunges securely into defense.
12.4: Roston Chase offers a full delivery outside off, and Mominul makes a watchful leave.

12.5: Roston Chase serves up a flighted delivery drifting onto off, allowing Mominul to kneel and sweep it away to the right of deep backward square leg for two runs, bringing up his milestone of 11,000 runs in first-class cricket.
12.6: Roston Chase drags his length back outside off, prompting Mominul to rock back and cut with the spin toward deep point to rotate the strike.
13.1: Justin Greaves angles a full delivery in toward off, and Mominul flicks it neatly through mid-wicket to collect a brace.
13.2: Justin Greaves bangs it in on a hard length angling down leg, and Mominul tries to tuck it across the line but misses entirely.
13.3: Justin Greaves delivers a full ball around off, and Mominul opens the face of his bat to gently tap it toward the slip cordon.
13.4: Justin Greaves pitches full on off, inviting Mominul to lean forward and drive toward mid-on where a diving fielder gets a hand to it and chases it down to save a run.
13.5: Justin Greaves targets a length outside off, and Shadman Islam watches it pass safely through to the keeper.
13.6: Justin Greaves persists on a good length outside off, and Shadman Islam works it smoothly around the corner.
14.1: Roston Chase drops it back of a length and extracts vicious turn past Shadman Islam's outside edge.
14.2: Roston Chase drifts one in full, allowing Shadman Islam to flick it sharply toward mid-on.
14.3: Roston Chase fires it full on leg-stump, and Mominul crouches low to sweep it briskly to the fine leg fence for four.
14.4: Roston Chase floats a full delivery on middle, clipped away by Mominul through mid-wicket for a comfortable couple.
14.5: Roston Chase angles it in on a length to Mominul, who stays rooted in his crease and expertly defends it.
14.6: Roston Chase tosses it up outside off, and Mominul drives firmly down to long-off to keep the strike.
15.1: Justin Greaves attacks the channel on a length, safely blocked into the off-side by Mominul.
15.2: Justin Greaves targets the good length outside off, successfully negotiated and defended by Mominul.
26.1: Joshua Bishop probes the channel outside off, and Shadman Islam strides forward to block.
26.2: Joshua Bishop offers flight outside off, allowing Shadman Islam to drive toward deepish mid-off for a single.
26.3: Joshua Bishop tosses it up full outside off, and Najmul Hossain Shanto strokes it cleanly down to mid-on.
26.4: Joshua Bishop drops short outside off, prompting Shadman Islam to cut against the spin past deep point for two.
26.5: Joshua Bishop floats one in from around off, turned firmly toward short mid-wicket where a diving stop denies Shadman Islam.
26.6: Joshua Bishop loops it full and turning into off, leaving Shadman Islam to dead-bat the ball safely.
27.1: Warrican fires it into the blockhole, forcing Najmul Hossain Shanto to scramble a single toward backward point.
27.2: Warrican finds turn into middle and leg, where Shadman Islam leans forward to defend toward short leg.
27.3: Warrican digs it back of a length on the stumps, allowing Shadman Islam to tuck it neatly around the corner.
27.4: Warrican attacks very full outside off, clipped slightly uppishly toward short mid-wicket by Najmul Hossain Shanto.
27.5: Warrican pulls back his length on off, met by the defensive prod of Najmul Hossain Shanto straight to short mid-wicket.
27.6: Warrican floats a full delivery outside off, driven by Najmul Hossain Shanto toward long-on to keep the strike.
28.1: Roston Chase drops it back on middle, and Najmul Hossain Shanto nudges the single neatly toward backward square leg.
28.2: Roston Chase fires it quicker and flatter into middle and off, cramping Shadman Islam who manages to drop his bat down in time.
28.3: Roston Chase drops this back of a length just outside off, and Shadman Islam punches it firmly straight to the covers.
28.4: Roston Chase pulls back his length on off stump, prompting Shadman Islam to hang deep and push the ball toward mid-off.
28.5: Roston Chase drifts one full toward the leg stump, where Shadman Islam strides forward to smother it safely toward short leg.
28.6: Roston Chase delivers a final sharp ball on off that Shadman Islam defends toward mid-on, signaling Lunch on Day 1.

34.2: Jayden Seales drops it short, allowing Shadman Islam to swivel back and pull securely into the deep square leg region for a single that brings up his tenth Test half-century and fourth against the West Indies, sparking a broad smile from Taskin.
34.3: Jayden Seales targets middle stump on a length, and Najmul Hossain Shanto simply nudges it into the vacant mid-wicket territory to rotate the strike.
34.4: Jayden Seales digs one in fractionally short outside off, forcing Shadman Islam to drag his hands across the line and mistime an awkward stroke wide of mid-on.
34.5: Jayden Seales spears a full delivery angling into the pads, but Najmul Hossain Shanto can only push his front foot forward and flick it straight to the stationed square leg fielder.
34.6: Jayden Seales tests the batter with a short of length delivery outside off, and Najmul Hossain Shanto gets well forward before deciding to offer an authoritative shoulder of arms.
35.1: Warrican floats a full delivery up on middle, prompting Shadman Islam to stride forward and firmly stroke it down toward long-on.
35.2: Warrican tosses one full outside off, and Najmul Hossain Shanto moves forward with a defensive prod back down the pitch as the silly mid-on fielder hovers close.

35.3: Warrican spears a full ball too straight for the intended paddle sweep, trapping Najmul Hossain Shanto plumb in front of middle and leg as a successful West Indies review ends a disappointed captain's stay.
35.4: Warrican tosses it up full on off and middle, inviting Towhid Hridoy forward into a dead-bat defensive push right back to the bowler.
35.5: Warrican serves up a full length on middle, and Towhid Hridoy presses forward to flick it smartly in front of mid-on for a brisk single to get off the mark.
35.6: Warrican drops back on a flat length on middle, and Shadman Islam rocks onto his back foot to glance it away toward deep square leg.
36.1: Shamar Joseph digs this one in short and wide outside off, drawing Shadman Islam onto the back foot for a mistimed cut that trickles wide of mid-off for two.
36.2: Shamar Joseph digs this short and wide outside off, and Shadman Islam slashes hard only to pick out Tagenarine stationed cleanly at cover.
36.3: Shamar Joseph angles this back-of-a-length delivery into off stump, squaring up Shadman Islam before deflecting away through the vacant backward point region for a single.
36.4: Shamar Joseph strays far too full and down the leg side, allowing Towhid Hridoy to whip it past fine-leg for a boundary as his bottom hand releases.
47.6: Joshua Bishop fires it short and wide, allowing Towhid Hridoy to drop back and carve it toward Warrican, who fumbles at cover but keeps the batsmen rooted.
48.1: Justin Greaves offers width outside off, tempting Shadman Islam onto the back foot for a firm cut that goes straight to Bishop at cover-point.
48.2: Justin Greaves finds the edge as Shadman Islam drives away from his body, the ball flashing past the desperate, outstretched left hand of Chase at slip to race away for four.
48.3: Justin Greaves tightens his line on middle and off, forcing Shadman Islam straight behind the line to absorb the delivery with a textbook defense.
48.4: Justin Greaves pitches it full and angles it inward, prompting Shadman Islam forward to dead-bat the ball solidly toward mid-off.
48.5: Justin Greaves digs it in short with extra bounce, forcing Shadman Islam onto his back foot to steer the ball safely toward cover.
48.6: Justin Greaves hits a probing length outside off that rears up off a good surface, leaving Shadman Islam to watch it sail past.
49.1: Joshua Bishop drops a flat good-length delivery that skids off the surface, inviting Towhid Hridoy back to punch it firmly toward cover.
49.2: Joshua Bishop tosses one up full and brisk on off, drawing Towhid Hridoy into a forward prod right back toward the bowler's right hand.
49.3: Joshua Bishop drifts it full down the leg side, allowing Towhid Hridoy to drop to one knee and sweep it away to deep backward square-leg for a single.
49.4: Joshua Bishop floats a slower delivery on middle, and Shadman Islam steps back to punch it straight to short mid-wicket.
49.5: Joshua Bishop loops it full onto the leg stump, where Shadman Islam easily strides forward to dead-bat it toward short mid-wicket.
49.6: Joshua Bishop darts it in flatter and quicker outside off, allowing Shadman Islam to drop onto the back foot and glide a single down to deep point.
50.1: Justin Greaves angles it short of a length just outside off, prompting Shadman Islam to step back and dead-bat it toward short cover.
50.2: Justin Greaves serves up a full one outside off, driven firmly by Shadman Islam before Seales swoops across with a sharp diving stop to his right at mid-off.
50.3: Justin Greaves tempts Shadman Islam with a very wide and full delivery, but the batter wisely lets it pass.
50.4: Justin Greaves hits a length outside off that holds its line, leaving Shadman Islam untroubled as he watches it through to the keeper.
50.5: Justin Greaves targets the back of a length just outside off, handled cleanly off the back foot by Shadman Islam as he defends it safely.
50.6: Justin Greaves pitches fullish just outside off, met by Shadman Islam with a resolute forward defence channeled straight to mid-off.
68.1: Warrican drifts one into the leg-stump, and Litton Das steps forward to safely smother it toward forward short-leg.
68.2: Warrican drops it flat on a good length, allowing Litton Das to slide back and nudge a single toward deep backward square-leg.
68.3: Warrican finds sharp turn from outside off, prompting Shadman Islam to retreat and let it pass through.
68.4: Warrican tosses it full outside off, and Shadman Islam advances to block it firmly back down the pitch.
68.5: Warrican zips through a quicker delivery on a good length, which Shadman Islam defends from the crease to silly mid-on.
68.6: Warrican strays down the leg-side, and Shadman Islam capitalizes with a gentle glance off the back foot to pick up two runs at fine-leg.
69.1: Joshua Bishop angles a flat good-length delivery outside off, and Litton Das dabs it away toward backward point from the back foot.
69.2: Joshua Bishop fires a very full ball onto middle, forcing Litton Das forward to dig it back out.
69.3: Joshua Bishop loops it full just outside off, and Litton Das gets ahead of the flight to dead-bat it to short cover.
69.4: Joshua Bishop offers a hint of width on a length, and Litton Das rocks back to execute a sublime late-cut past backward point for four.
69.5: Joshua Bishop spears one down leg where Litton Das sweeps into his pad, watching the ball dribble past Amir Jangoo and the leg-stump.
69.6: Joshua Bishop slows up a full delivery on leg-stump, which Litton Das meets on the front foot to block toward short mid-wicket.
71.4: Joshua Bishop tosses it up outside off, and Litton Das steps forward to push it firmly toward extra cover.
71.5: Joshua Bishop sends down a full one sliding past the leg stump, where Litton Das swings hard for the sweep but fails to make contact.
71.6: Joshua Bishop floats it full on off stump, inviting Litton Das to press forward into a sturdy defensive block.
72.1: Shamar Joseph charges in at 134.3kph, finding a thick inside edge off Shadman Islam's tentative push that trickles away to short mid-wicket.
72.2: Shamar Joseph delivers back of a length on middle, and Shadman Islam rises on his toes to work a single toward deep mid-wicket.
72.3: Shamar Joseph steams in at 135kph, offering a full delivery that Litton Das dead-bats off the front foot toward the cover region.
72.4: Shamar Joseph drops it short of a length outside off, allowing Litton Das to glide it smoothly down to third man.
72.5: Shamar Joseph targets the hips on a hard length, and Shadman Islam tucks it away to fine leg to advance to 98.
72.6: Shamar Joseph angles one in short of a length, prompting Litton Das to hop and nudge it neatly round the corner.
73.1: Warrican lands it on a length around off stump, with Litton Das covering the line to play a sound defensive stroke.
73.2: Warrican drifts a full delivery into middle and leg, safely patted down into the pitch by the batsman.
73.3: Warrican floats it full on off, catching the inner edge of Litton Das's forward prod as it loops away toward short leg.
73.4: Warrican tosses it up on middle and leg, coaxed softly toward mid-off as hesitation gives way to a desperate, successful scramble for a single.
73.5: Warrican drops it slightly shorter outside off and gets it to turn in, met by a compact short-arm jab straight to short mid-wicket.
73.6: Warrican loops it up on off, Shadman Islam flicks it toward mid-on and charges across for the single that carries him to ninety-nine.
